subject: Canoe paddler
parts: a stick figure with a detached hollow circle head above a bent single-line seated torso and one arm reaching right, a shallow U-shaped open canoe hull below the figure with two raised tips and no horizontal gunwale line, and a diagonal single-bladed paddle entirely to the right of the hull with a hollow rounded blade; leave broad white gaps separating the head, seated body, canoe hull, and paddle so the paddle never crosses the canoe
warnings: Selected best of three attempts. Strokes remain thinner than requested; seated figure joins the canoe rim.
